About this Event

✨ Old Is Gold – Chai Rave Dance Party ✨
Love timeless Bollywood classics? Relive the golden era, dance to evergreen hits, sip on chai & groove to fun hook steps at Old Is Gold Chai Rave Dance Party! ☕💃🎶
Get ready for a nostalgic trip down memory lane as we bring back the magic of Bollywood’s golden hits! From unforgettable melodies to iconic dance numbers, it’s time to revisit your favorite memories, sing along, and dance your heart out! 💛
SoulBeats brings you Bombay Jam Old Is Gold Chai Rave Dance Party where retro Bollywood vibes meet high-energy Bombay Jam moves, fun, easy-to-follow hook steps, and the warmth of chai!
✨ Old songs. Golden memories. Endless dancing. ✨
